description:
The network quality control system needs to be configured. The SeisComP quality control module `scqc` monitors waveform data streams in real time, detecting data gaps, timing quality problems, and other anomalies. Currently, scqc has no custom configuration and is using defaults that are inappropriate for the GE network's reporting requirements.

Open scconfig and navigate to the Module Parameters section for `scqc`. Apply the following four configuration changes:

1. Set `report.interval` to `60`  (report QC parameters every 60 seconds)
2. Set `report.buffer` to `3600`  (buffer 3600 seconds = 1 hour of QC history)
3. Set `streamMask` to `GE.*.*.*`  (monitor all streams in the GE network)
4. Set `realtime.buffer` to `1800`  (use 1800 seconds of real-time sliding window)

After applying all four parameters, save and update the configuration so the values are written to the scqc configuration file at `/home/ga/seiscomp/etc/scqc.cfg`.
